data.title: Understanding de-dollarisation
data.description: The past year, 2025, marked one of the most volatile and structurally transformative periods in the history of modern global finance. We witnessedgold hit an All-Time High28 times, while the US Dollar Index (DXY) plummeted severely by-9.5%ina single year—one of its steepest annual declines. These phenomena are not coincidental; they are the result of macroeconomic forces that have been building for decades.

data.title: PP accused of proxy voting
data.description: The Democrat Party on Monday called for an investigation into alleged proxy voting by People's Party councillors during a recent Bangkok Metropolitan Council (BMC) meeting, saying it would file a complaint with the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC).

data.title: Masseuses claim abduction by fake cops
data.description: Three employees of a Pattaya massage shop have accused men posing as police officers of abducting them, threatening to frame them on drug charges and extorting money for their release.

data.title: WWII shells surface in wildfire-ravaged French village
data.description: LE PORGE (FRANCE) - A huge forest fire near Bordeaux in southwestern France has revealed World War II shells in the village of Le Porge, where all residents returned to their homes on Monday after days of demining operations.

data.title: Trump says Iran facing 'last chance before decapitation'
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump said Monday that negotiations with Iran were ongoing despite Tehran's denials and the Islamic Republic was facing a "last chance before decapitation."

data.title: Last Scottish island bird hunt banned after almost 500 years
data.description: LONDON - A centuries-old annual bird chick hunt on a remote Scottish island, known as the Guga Hunt, has been banned this year, the authorities said Monday, citing conservation concerns.

data.title: Infantino, the FIFA president under pressure after scrapped investor plan
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - FIFA president Gianni Infantino's ability to brush aside criticism and push through enlarged versions of the Club World Cup and World Cup lent him an air of omnipotence, but a failed private investor plan has left his position under threat for the first time.

data.title: US regulators grant long-awaited Boeing 737 MAX 7 certificate
data.description: NEW YORK - More than eight years after Boeing organized the maiden flight of the 737 MAX 7, US authorities announced Monday that they certified the aircraft.

data.title: The StandardX hosts art show 'Urban Collectibles' on Phra Arthit Road
data.description: "Urban Collectibles" returns for its landmark fifth edition to create a point of stillness at The StandardX, Bangkok Phra Arthit daily from 1pm to 9pm, from Friday to Sunday.

data.title: Examine your internal universe at 'Supernova'
data.description: 6060 Arts Space presents "Supernova", an exhibition that takes viewers into a psychological universe where they can move gradually through forces of attraction, memory, desire, conflict, fragmentation and renewal, from Thursday to Aug 29.

data.title: LGBTIs keep sexuality under wraps on holiday
data.description: Booking.com has found that more than half of Thai LGBTI tourists do not "come out" on holiday to avoid negative experiences.

data.title: Beyond the unrest
data.description: Chaiyos Pinpradab, founder of the magazine Phuket Bulletin, is now retired and living in his home on the island. Whenever he hears news regarding loss of innocent lives during local unrest, he is heartbroken.

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Aug 4
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: Polluted rivers spark protest
data.description: The People's Network for the Protection of the Kok, Sai, Ruak and Mekong rivers yesterday protested outside the Myanmar Consulate-General in Chiang Mai, calling for action over mining-related pollution in Myanmar that has affected several rivers in northern Thailand.

data.title: YouTuber's body to return from Georgia
data.description: The Thai embassy in Ankara is coordinating with Georgian authorities to repatriate the body of Thai travel YouTuber Bawornthat "Hlun Solo" Pengsuk after his family authorised the embassy to handle the process, the Foreign Ministry said.

data.title: Si Sa Ket station to  undergo renovations
data.description: Si Sa Ket Railway Station will undergo upgrades to its forecourt, fountain plaza and passenger facilities as authorities prepare for the 44.1-billion-baht Phase 2 double-track railway linking Thanon Chira Junction and Ubon Ratchathani.

data.title: Atiruj ends long wait with Pattaya triumph
data.description: Atiruj Winaicharoenchai finally claimed the title he had coveted for nearly a decade, edging home by a single stroke to win the Singha Pattaya Open at Laem Chabang International Country Club on Sunday.

data.title: Villa roll into city to play BG
data.description: Fresh from their Europa League triumph, Aston Villa continue their Asian pre‑season tour tonight with a meeting against Thai Premier League side BG Pathum United at True BG Stadium.

data.title: Dig uncovers lost wall section
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA: Archaeologists have uncovered a long-lost eastern section of the Korat city wall, a major discovery not seen in more than two decades.

data.title: Health ministry steps up weed enforcement rules
data.description: The Ministry of Public Health has stepped up enforcement of cannabis rules, revealing the results of operations conducted since October.

data.title: Kingdom's spikers reign, sweep Vietnam
data.description: The Thai women's volleyball team put on a strong performance in the championship decider of 2026 SEA V Cup first leg, decisively defeating hosts Vietnam 3-0 (25-18, 25-17, 25-14) in Hanoi on Sunday night.

data.title: Hudson demands ruthless display
data.description: Thailand will look to maintain their perfect start to the Asean Hyundai Cup when they face hosts, the Philippines, in New Clark City tonight, with head coach Anthony Hudson insisting his side must keep their concentration despite back‑to‑back victories that have already underlined their credentials.

data.title: PP rules out future cooperation with BJT
data.description: The People's Party (PP) has learned its lesson from supporting Anutin Charnvirakul's bid for the premiership, deputy leader Sirikanya Tansakun said on Monday, apologising to the public and ruling out future cooperation with the ruling Bhumjaithai Party (BJT).

data.title: Korrawee to sue iLaw director
data.description: Bhumjaithai MP for Ang Thong Korrawee Prisananantakul on Monday authorised his lawyer to file a defamation complaint against iLaw director Yingcheep Atchanont over allegations linking him to the alleged Senate election collusion case.

data.title: RFD widens Phuket land crackdown
data.description: The Royal Forestry Department (RFD) on Monday expanded its crackdown on alleged forest encroachment in Phuket, targeting eight locations as part of the government's "Phuket Model" policy to reclaim illegally occupied land.

data.title: PP accused of proxy voting
data.description: The Democrat Party on Monday called for an investigation into alleged proxy voting by People's Party councillors during a recent Bangkok Metropolitan Council (BMC) meeting, saying it would file a complaint with the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC).

data.title: PP MP, actor, answer DSI summons in forex case
data.description: People's Party (PP) list-MP Pawoot Pongvitayapanu and actor Rattapoom "Film" Tokongsup separately reported to the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) on Monday to acknowledge charges in connection with an alleged illegal foreign exchange (forex) trading scheme.

data.title: PM blasts UN border report
data.description: Thailand has rejected a UN special rapporteur's report estimating that 650,000 Cambodians were internally displaced during recent border clashes, saying the findings relied on one-sided information and failed to include Thailand's perspective.

data.title: ONE Championship: Aliff backed for Malaysia homecoming after historic Anwar meeting
data.description: Aliff Sor Dechapan’s historic title triumph has taken him to the Malaysian Prime Minister’s Office – and growing calls for the country’s first ONE Championship world champion to fight on home soil could help shape what comes next.

data.title: Survivors recall blasts before deadly Indonesian ferry fire
data.description: SURABAYA - Survivors said on Monday they heard multiple blasts moments before an Indonesian passenger ferry caught fire, killing five people and prompting many to jump into the sea, with rescuers still searching the waters more than a day later.

data.title: Fifa's Infantino sought Trump backing after failed World Cup sell-off plan
data.description: LONDON — Fédération Internationale de Football Association (Fifa) President ⁠Gianni ⁠Infantino sought support ​from the Donald Trump administration amid mounting criticism after ​his abandoned plan to sell a stake in World Cup commercial rights, the New York Post said on Monday, citing sources familiar with the matter.

data.title: Questions swirl over Bhumjaithai unity
data.description: Although Bhumjaithai (BJT) leaders insist the party remains united, a series of recent developments has fuelled speculation over whether Thailand's dominant coalition partner is facing more than routine political tensions.

data.title: Thailand among top destinations for Koreans in drug‑trafficking cases
data.description: Thailand ranked second only to Cambodia for cases in which South Koreans were caught trying to transport illicit drugs to third countries, according to data compiled by the Foreign Affairs Ministry in Seoul and reported by a South Korean lawmaker.

data.title: Israel conveys 'concerns' to US on Gaza plan and keeps striking
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israel said Monday it had conveyed concern to the United States on a plan to end the Gaza war hailed by President Donald Trump as it kept up strikes in the Palestinian territory.
